name: ui-inspector
description: UI/UX inspection via headless Chromium — screenshot, interact (click/type/scroll), ARIA accessibility tree, computed CSS, axe-core a11y audit, and page metrics. No external daemon required. Ships as its own repo: github.com/alexandrocuma/mcp-ui-inspector
setup_instructions:
ui-inspector ships as its own repo:
  git clone https://github.com/alexandrocuma/mcp-ui-inspector
  cd mcp-ui-inspector && ./setup.sh
Then set UI_INSPECTOR_DIR to that directory and re-run ./install.sh --mcps-only
